exposure: Timing of birth (pre-COVID-19 vs. during COVID-19 pandemic)
outcome: Use of synthetic milk for feeding neonates
finding: Pregnant women who gave birth during the COVID-19 pandemic had a higher risk of preterm labor and a lower risk of cesarean delivery compared to those who gave birth before the pandemic.
mod_finding: The study found a lower risk of cesarean delivery among pregnant women who gave birth during the COVID-19 pandemic.
